SRC-229:R001.text: Verify whether the sidecar is genuinely absent from the live authoritative project tree.

SRC-229:R002.text: Identify the original ledger citation and any authorized recovery location.

SRC-229:R003.text: Check whether a durable verified source contains byte-identical or hash-verifiable original evidence.

SRC-229:R004.text: If recovery is possible, use only the canonical evidence recovery mechanism.

SRC-229:R005.text: If recovery is not possible, preserve the incomplete verdict and record the unresolved integrity incident.

SRC-229:R006.text: Check whether the canonical validator correctly distinguishes missing evidence from an exporter omission.

SRC-229:R007.text: Do not interpret Wintage T-916 BUILD as an engine failure unless independent evidence demonstrates such a failure; do not rewrite T-916 on behalf of its active owner.

SRC-229:R008.text: No Wintage product modifications, historical evidence fabrication, hand edits to STATE/BOARD/LOG, deleting citation to make validation green, broad protocol migration, or weakening of evidence integrity rules.
